findings.required_behavior: Explicit extension maps exist at canonical object levels and optional extensions survive schema validation, canonicalization, and serialization.
findings.negative_test: unknown direct property remains rejected outside explicit extensions map
findings.positive_test: unknown optional extension map value validates and survives round-trip

findings.required_behavior: Mutable status and queue/controller fields do not affect manifest_payload_digest or distribution_digest; immutable spec/metadata/artifact changes do.
findings.negative_test: status.status, recommended_next_task, proposed_capability, and non-capability booleans changed only
findings.positive_test: metadata identity, artifact digest, and component digest changed

findings.required_behavior: Component refs and ids are unique, component content digests recompute, artifact refs and dependencies close, and dependency cycles fail.
findings.negative_test: corrupt digest, missing artifact, excluded artifact, unknown dependency, duplicate id, self dependency, dependency cycle
findings.positive_test: generated component closes over all included artifacts

findings.required_behavior: Included local artifacts validate path, regular file status, byte count, content digest, media type, compression type, checksum ref, and provenance ref.
findings.negative_test: wrong byte_count, wrong media_type, wrong compression_format
findings.positive_test: Q47 included local artifacts recompute successfully

findings.required_behavior: Release artifact records reject absolute, traversal, UNC, drive, and forbidden paths before stat/open/hash.
findings.negative_test: malformed release record path cannot trigger filesystem probe
findings.positive_test: valid relative release path is hashed after containment validation

findings.required_behavior: Checksum manifest algorithm, digest, exact checksum key, value equality, and basename-collision behavior are validated.
findings.negative_test: correct checksum name with wrong value and basename collision
findings.positive_test: Q47 checksum values match artifact content digests

findings.required_behavior: Protocol min/max, v1 inclusion, reader/writer versions, component constraints, unknown required features, optional features, and migrations are enforced.
findings.negative_test: min above v1, max below v1, missing min, missing reader/writer, malformed versions, incompatible component constraints

findings.required_behavior: Local-directory inventory records forbidden members and validation fails with contamination evidence instead of silently filtering.
findings.negative_test: directory containing .aide.local or source report member fails

findings.required_behavior: Committed fixture corpus contains direct valid/invalid fixtures for the required adversarial matrix.
findings.negative_test: required invalid fixture list exists and fails with expected codes
findings.positive_test: required valid fixture list exists and passes
